nodes.label: Frontend Agent Definition (iot-front-implementador)
nodes.description: Claude agent definition for Vue 3 SPA implementation. Single Echo instance per tab via echo.js. Channel registry for subscription lifecycle. Alert projection owner is alerts.js store. SensorMonitorBoard owns merge/history/MAX_POINTS. Reuse base components and formatters.js. Mobile-first target: 320/360/390/430 phone, 768 tablet, 1440 desktop. No polling fallback. Lifecycle-triggered recovery.
nodes.rationale: Defines the frontend agent conventions: single Echo connection, alert projection ownership, and mobile-first responsive targets. Critical for understanding the realtime architecture and component ownership boundaries.
